parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries returned. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The cursor for pagination. Leave this parameter empty for the first request. When the returned value is empty, all data has been retrieved.

parameters.name: PolicyName
parameters.description: The name of the notification policy. Supports fuzzy matching.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun schedulerx2 read-schedulerx-notification-policy --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --policy-name test-weekdays --max-results 10 --next-token O39nXKu5XafATl3/cJjSJw== --region cn-hangzhou
